blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY— The bishop of Boac has expressed solidarity with fisherfolk and coastal communities in the Verde Island Passage (VIP), backing calls for stronger marine protection, justice and the defense of municipal waters. In a pastoral solidarity message, Bishop Edwin O. Panergo of the Diocese of Boac supported Caritas Philippines’ appeal to protect the biodiverse marine corridor, which sustains fishing communities and coastal livelihoods. Panergo said threats to marine ecosystems were not merely environmental or economic concerns but also matters of human dignity, particularly for families who depend on the sea for their daily needs.
